# Senior prompt engineer — system prompts, agent instructions and structured output patterns

Curated by Skill Harbor — @davila7's senior-prompt-engineer skill: a prompt-crafting toolkit for production LLM work. Covers system-prompt architecture, instruction hierarchy and precedence, few-shot example design, structured-output patterns (JSON schemas, constrained formats), evaluation loops for prompt quality, and ready-made templates to start from. Honest caveats: prompting best practices shift as models evolve — treat templates as starting points and evaluate against your target model; general by design — the value is in the patterns, not in copy-paste magic. MIT licensed. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Discovered via skills.sh.
